text.tspan: Shaded: median |r| = 0.01 across associations. Dotted: |r| = 0.06, the top 1% of all associations; in e-h, the 95% interval reaches ±0.06 at n = 1,000. Associations per level: thickness
vertex 59,412, ROI 333, network 13; RSFC edge 77,421, component 100, network 105. Samples A and B are two independent n = 25 subsamples; the dashed line is the full sample
(n = 3,604 thickness, n = 3,928 RSFC). Brain maps (c, d) and the psychopathology RSFC scatter (h, right) are not drawn: not in the source data.
